item.name: WildApricot Get List of Invoices by Criteria.

request.name: WildApricot Get List of Invoices by Criteria.

description.content: âš  There are 3 parameters, which cannot be used simultaneously. API uses only one parameter of contactId, eventId and eventRegistrationId exactly in this order. For example if request contains both contactId and eventId, then API uses only contactId to filter invoices.

query.description: Identifier of contact to whom the invoice is assigned.
Identifier of event. When specified API returns collection of invoices associated with event registrations for the event.
Identifier of event registration. When specified API returns invoice related to the registration. Usually a single invoice.
When set to true, API returns only unpaid invoices.
When set to true, API returns only paid invoices.
When set to true, API also returns voided invoices.
When set to true, API returns only collection of identifiers instead of collection of invoices.
Limits result to invoices created since StartDate.
Limits result to invoices created before EndDate.

response.name: Collection of invoices that match criteria.
